en.description:
Wrist Ninja — Slice. Train. Ascend.

The original Apple Watch fruit-slicing game is back — bigger than ever on iPhone and iPad. Swipe to slice, dodge the bombs, build combos… and earn your place in Master Poo's Dojo.

WELCOME TO THE DOJO
An all-new world with hand-crafted art. Your sensei is watching. Train hard, earn shurikens, and climb from white belt to black.

DOJO JOURNEY
60 levels across six belts. Slice trials, survival gauntlets, score challenges — and a boss battle at the end of every belt. Three stars per level. Earn them all.

TEN REALMS TO MASTER
Every realm is a full world: its own fruit, its own arena. Slice through the Orchard Dojo, the Neon Night Market, the Chaos Rift, the Golden Palace, and more. Unlock realms with skill or shurikens — or grab everything at once with a single purchase.

SIX WAYS TO PLAY
Free Play — Classic survival. No clock, no mercy.
Arcade — 60 seconds. Slice everything.
Zen — No bombs, no pressure. Just vibes and fruit.
Daily Trial — One seeded run per day. Same fruit, same bombs, same shot for everyone. Global leaderboard.
Clan Tournament — A new seeded run every Monday. Seven days to climb.
Dojo Journey — The campaign. Belts, bosses, glory.

EARN SHURIKENS
Every slice pays. Spend shurikens on realms, blade trails (Shadow, Gold, Sakura, Fire, Rainbow), continues, boosters, and streak protection. Collect your daily Training Stipend just for showing up.

SENSEI'S ORDERS
Three fresh missions every day, plus a cross-device challenge that spans your wrist and your phone. Everyone gets the same orders. Not everyone completes them.

APPLE WATCH
The original. Slice on your wrist anywhere — scores, quests, and shurikens sync to your iPhone automatically, and the complication tracks your progress right on the watch face.

CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS
Send a challenge in iMessage. They play, you rematch, the bubble keeps score. Ties are dishonorable.

GAME CENTER
Global and weekly leaderboards, 13 achievements, personal bests, and win streaks across every device.

No ads? No problem. One purchase removes all ads permanently, on every device.

Wrist Ninja is free to play. No subscriptions. No pay-to-win — shurikens never buy score, only style. Just your reflexes against an endless stream of flying fruit.

The dojo asks little. The dojo asks you.

versionHistory.releaseNotes: Emoji fruit! Unlock Junk Food, Poop Mode, Face Pack and Chaos skins by beating score milestones.

v1.2

- Difficulty Modes: Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard before each game. 
  Harder modes tighten blade precision, increase bombs, and speed up spawns.
- Daily Challenge: A new seeded game mode where every player slices the 
  same fruit sequence. One attempt per day, one global leaderboard.
- Dagger Blade Indicator: Your blade angle is now shown as a dagger in 
  the corner. Rotate the crown to aim it before you swipe.
- Skin Sync: Skin selection on your iPhone now syncs to your Watch.
- Bug fixes and performance improvements.

Weekly leaderboards are here. Rankings reset every Monday so there's always a fresh competition — no one stays on top forever.

Also in this update:

8 Game Center achievements to unlock, from your first slice to surviving 30 daily challenges
Friend notifications let you know when someone beats your personal best
Haptic feedback tuned for every moment — new personal best, game over, combo chains
Share card now shows your streak and difficulty alongside your score
Bug fixes and performance improvements.

Wrist Ninja is now a universal app — play on iPhone and iPad, not just Apple Watch.

Full iPhone and iPad game with landscape gameplay
Three modes: Free Play, Arcade, and Zen
Unlockable skin packs: Junk Food, Poop, Face Pack, and Chaos
Sound effects including a special one for slicing poo
Dynamic background that reacts to your score
Interstitial ads between games (remove them with one purchase)
Remove Ads and Unlock All Skins in-app purchases
Game Center leaderboards and stats sync across all devices
Pause and quit from any game mode
Apple Watch gameplay is unchanged. All existing scores and streaks carry over.

What's New in 2.1

• iMessage Challenges — Dare a friend to beat your score without leaving Messages 
• Space Pack — Rocket ships, astronauts & lunar chaos. Unlock at 750 points • iCloud sync — Your unlocks, best scores, and skin follow you across all your devices automatically • Scores now sync between Apple Watch and iPhone in real time • Performance improvements and bug fixes

Version 2.2 brings the biggest update yet.

4 new skin packs — Street Food, Fantasy, Sports, and Premium. Unlock them by improving your score, or grab everything at once.

Daily Missions — 3 new goals every day. Everyone gets the same missions. Complete them to prove you're more than a one-trick ninja.

Ranked Tiers — your rank now shows on the home screen. Climb from Beginner all the way to Immortal.

Power-ups — one per game. Slow-Mo, Double Points, or Frenzy. Tap the button when you need it.

Weekly Tournament — a new seeded run every Monday. Same sequence for every player. One leaderboard, one week to own it.

Game Center Achievements — 13 new achievements to hunt. Some are easy. Some are not.

Plus: tighter combo system, bug fixes, and performance improvements.

Bug fixes across iPhone, Apple Watch, and iMessage — Slow-Mo works properly, everyone gets the same Daily Challenge fruit, the "no bombs" mission is finally completable, and rematches send your real score. Keep slicing!
